coverage_basis.rationale: Primary activity model uses time-varying trajectory, rotation and water production.
This campaign does not establish a complete source-region map for all activity.
Activity is represented as epoch-dependent rather than permanent.

geology_geotechnical.notes: Morphology and global physical interpretation are represented; local mechanical properties remain unresolved.

coverage_basis.rationale: Rosetta RSI primary analysis reports GM, mass and bulk density.
NASA PDS preserves multiple mission shape models.
Gravity analysis reports a global density/porosity interpretation with explicit model class.

history.notes: Mission chronology is represented, not a complete publication/adoption history.

coverage_basis.rationale: ESA mission document identifies the target and mission.
PDS/ESA archive identifies Rosetta and Philae data holdings.
VIRTIS primary analysis addresses the organic-rich surface.
ROSINA primary analysis provides integrated elemental/molecular interpretation.
No direct deep-interior composition measurement was admitted.

orbit_geometry.notes: No cutoff-safe orbit-element artifact was acquired in this bounded campaign.

regional.notes: The acquired shape model is global; a full region/site evidence matrix was not acquired.

coverage_basis.rationale: PDS shape dataset includes a body-centered reference frame.
No scalar rotation solution was extracted in this bounded transfer campaign.
VIRTIS primary analysis reports time-resolved surface temperature maps and resolution.
The source explicitly treats diurnal and seasonal variation.
This campaign does not establish a general subsurface thermal profile.
ROSINA source reports major volatile species in the coma.
Coma measurements and model inversion do not by themselves establish a complete local nucleus inventory.
ROSINA source covers production distributions over the mission.

unresolved_gaps.description: No cutoff-safe orbit-element artifact acquired in this bounded campaign.
